$comment: Components available but explicitly UNSTABLE — kern's incubator channel
(the `lab` equivalent). Each entry needs a reason; an entry without one
is a claim, not a decision.
The generator fails on any name not in the manifest, so a removed or
renamed component cannot linger here silently. Delete the entry when the
component graduates; the state then derives from the package version like
